title: Palantir depth-6 controls, ethics and financing analysis
summary: Depth 6 converts four broad leads into bounded public-record conclusions and explicit document-production gaps.

data.question: What do public records establish about the IRS Unified API authorization boundary, Barbaccia's Palantir ethics file, Rockbridge inter-entity flows and Vulcan's OSC diligence chronology?
data.method: Primary-source extraction, dated chronology, legal-entity separation, transaction classification and explicit negative-search handling.
data.framework: Evidence-first controls, ethics and financial-ledger analysis.
data.scope: Four depth-6 investigation targets selected from the Palantir depth-5 controls chronology.
findings: Treasury and award records establish a common IRS API/semantic layer but not its deployed authorization boundary, consumers, roles or privacy approvals.

Barbaccia disclosed a small PLTR holding; the value range is reported as covered by a criminal-conflict exemption, but public screening, recusal, participation and disposition records remain incomplete.
Huemme's OGE filing directly establishes overlapping compensated development roles at Better Tomorrow and Rockbridge Network LLC; it does not establish inter-entity transfers.

Vulcan's 1789 investment preceded a conditional OSC commitment; reported White House initiation is documented by investigative reporting and congressional inquiry, while closing and disbursement remain unproven.
conclusions: The strongest new evidence is not a single conspiracy chain but four distinct control/ethics/financing records with different legal and evidentiary meanings.

Public data supports operational overlap and sequence analysis; it does not yet support claims of consolidated Rockbridge ownership, a Barbaccia criminal conflict, an IRS authorization bypass or a disbursed Vulcan loan.
The next evidentiary gain requires agency and filing documents rather than more narrative reporting.
recommendations: Request the Unified API SOW, SSP/ATO letter, control-responsibility matrix, PIA determination, role matrix and audit-retention schedule.
Request OMB ethics agreement, screening arrangement, Palantir participation records and subsequent Barbaccia transaction reports.
Obtain Better Tomorrow Schedule L XML/PDF details, Delaware LLC records and itemized FEC/vendor data.
Obtain OSC intake, credit review, conditions precedent, executed warrant/equity documents, closing and disbursement records, plus White House communications.
counterarguments: FedRAMP authorization and inherited EDP controls may cover much of the Unified API implementation even though the mapping is not public.
The Barbaccia PLTR position may be legally exempt and operationally screened without a public memorandum.
Shared personnel is common among aligned organizations and does not prove common ownership or improper transfers.
Expedited review can coexist with rigorous diligence, and a conditional commitment may never disburse.
limitations: No subpoena return, FOIA production, complete contract SOW, full Schedule L counterpart ledger, OMB participation log or executed OSC financing package was available.
Negative search results are recorded as public-record gaps, not proof of nonexistence.
unresolved: Barbaccia PLTR disposition and participation controls
Rockbridge beneficial ownership and inter-entity payments
Vulcan closing, disbursement and full diligence record
